title: Avoid Using Sanitary Tees in Horizontal Waste Lines
description: A frequent installation mistake in waste pipe systems is using a standard sanitary tee to connect horizontal drain lines. Sanitary tees are designed for vertical-to-horizontal transitions where gravity aids direction. In a horizontal-to-horizontal orientation, a sanitary tee lacks the long directional sweep required to direct solids smoothly, leading to waste accumulation, frequent clogs, and improper flow dynamics. Always use a combination wye and 1/8 bend fitting for horizontal waste branch connections according to standard plumbing practices and local building code requirements.

Avoid Using Sanitary Tees in Horizontal Waste Lines

A frequent installation mistake in waste pipe systems is using a standard sanitary tee to connect horizontal drain lines. Sanitary tees are designed for vertical-to-horizontal transitions where gravity aids direction. In a horizontal-to-horizontal orientation, a sanitary tee lacks the long directional sweep required to direct solids smoothly, leading to waste accumulation, frequent clogs, and improper flow dynamics. Always use a combination wye and 1/8 bend fitting for horizontal waste branch connections according to standard plumbing practices and local building code requirements.
